Kendujhar district · PARAKH Baseline Assessment · Grade 2

Foundational literacy & numeracy report cards

Every child was assessed on five literacy and five numeracy competencies. Each competency is reported on its own; results are never averaged across competencies. Use the tabs above to open a block, cluster or school.

How to read the results

Percentages show the share of assessed children at each level for that one competency. Literacy (Lit1–Lit5) and Numeracy (Num1–Num5) are shown separately. Records with Roll Number 0 are not included.

Block map

Choose a competency and a level. Each block is shaded by the share of its children at that level. Click a block to open its report.

    Reading comprehension & subtraction
